description: This source file provides a helper class 'DotNetHelper' that implements missing .NET 6 features for earlier .NET Framework versions, specifically a method to create BigInteger instances from byte spans with additional options.

classes.name: DotNetHelper
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to emulate .NET 6 features for earlier framework versions, mainly for creating BigInteger from byte spans.

methods.name: CreateBigInteger
methods.description: Creates a BigInteger instance from a ReadOnlySpan<byte>, with options for unsigned interpretation and endianness conversion.
